# Digital Spy

> Digital Spy is the UK's premier entertainment news destination covering TV shows, movies, soaps, streaming guides, and celebrity gossip with in-depth analysis and community discussion.

Digital Spy provides comprehensive entertainment coverage across television (including reality TV and soaps like EastEnders, Coronation Street, and Emmerdale), movies, streaming services, and tech gadgets. The site combines breaking news, spoilers, reviews, features, and an active community forum for fans to discuss their favorite shows and entertainment topics.

## Core Entertainment Hubs

- [Digital Spy Homepage](https://www.digitalspy.com): Homepage featuring latest TV, movie, soap and entertainment news

- [Movie News, Reviews, and Previews](https://www.digitalspy.com/movies): Movie news, trailers, reviews and release date information
- [Soaps - Latest Spoilers, News and Gossip](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps): Soap opera spoilers, news and gossip for major UK and Australian shows
